annualReturns.source: Yahoo Finance historical close and adjusted-close data; calendar endpoints checked through November 18, 2026

methodology.calculation: Full-year price return uses the final available split-adjusted close of each calendar year relative to the final available close of the prior calendar year. AMDL’s 2024 launch-to-year-end partial period is described separately and excluded from completed-year summary statistics.
methodology.current_year: 2026 YTD is measured from the final 2025 close through November 18, 2026. The current calendar year is excluded from completed-year summary statistics.
